title: Media Uploads: Slugified Names, Resumable Uploads and Live Updates | Orchard Core
description:
Folder and file names with spaces and symbols end up in web addresses, a large upload that stops has to start again, and a Media Library open in another window shows an out-of-date file list.

Three features of the Orchard Core Media module handle these cases: Media Slugify cleans the names of the folders you create and the files you upload, Media TUS Uploads sends files in parts that you can pause and resume, and Media SignalR keeps every open Media Library up to date.

In this video:
• What the three upload features are for
• Enabling them under Tools, Features
• Slugified names for folders and files
• Pausing, resuming and recovering an upload
• Live updates in a second browser window
• What to plan for when a site runs on several servers
